parsed.summary: The netlist is a renumbered but functionally equivalent implementation of the specified m5-pantilt design: the battery switch, external 5V diode, servo rail diode/capacitors, PWM selection jumpers, serial bridge jumpers, and MAX3485 UART/direction-control network all match the intended connectivity and values. No evidence of a behavior-changing anomaly was found.

We have spec for m5-pantilt. Netlist has components with refs/values different from spec. Need compare intended design vs files. Anomaly = deviation from intended design that would make board behave differently. Could be design error, assembly/sourcing mistake, tampering. Need report if supported.

Let's parse spec:
- J1/J2 Conn_02x15_Odd_Even top/bottom M5Stack bus connectors identical nets pass-through. Carries +5V, +3V3, BAT, GND, GPIO/UART pins TXD2/RXD2 PortC, two PortB GPIOs through to J6.
- J3,J8 Conn_01x03 servo header ch1/ch2. Pin3 signal.
- J5 Conn_01x02 BAT battery input gated through Q1 to /BAT bus pin.
- J6 Conn_01x04 M5Unit PortB breakout GND,+5V,two GPIOs passed through from J1/J2.
- J7 Conn_01x02 5V_POWER external 5V input.
- D1 SS54 Schottky series between J7 external 5V in and board +5V rail.
- D2 PMEG3030EP Schottky from +5V into servo power rail feeding J3/J8 pin2 and C1-C4.
- C1-C4 100u bulk on servo rail.
- C5 0.1u decoupling on +3V3 MAX3485 supply.
- Q1 IRLML6402 P-MOSFET high-side battery disconnect: gates battery connector (J5) onto /BAT bus net.
- SW1 SPDT optional manual power switch; pulls Q1 gate low via R5 47k to turn battery path on.
- Q2 BC857 PNP auto TX/RX direction control: driven from /TXD2 via R1 10k, R2 5.1k to toggle MAX3485 DE/RE enable.
- U1 MAX3485.
- R1,R2 10k,5.1k bias divider from /TXD2 into Q2 base.
- R6,R7,R8,R15 2k,20k,2.2k,2.2k bias/pull network on MAX3485 A/B differential lines and DE/RE enable line.
- R3,R4 1k each series resistors from PWM1/PWM2 GPIO nets to J3 pin3/J8 pin3 respectively.
- R9-R12 0 jumpers select bus pin 19/21 for ch1, 20/22 for ch2 supplies PWM1/PWM2.
- R13,R14 0 jumpers when shorted bridge J3-pin3 and J8-pin3 together and onto MAX3485 TTL bus.

Need check if anomaly exists. Could be deliberate tampering? Need compare with spec. There are many ref/value mismatches. But spec may not mention every component? It does mention values. Need see if netlist is a different build with correct function? Let's infer actual circuit.

- Battery path: J2 (BAT) pin1 to Q2 S, pin2 GND. Q2 IRLML6402 P-FET: S pin2 to battery, D pin3 to /BAT net J1.29/J8.29. Gate Q2.1 to Net-(Q2-G): R23.1, SW2.2. R23.2 to Net-(J2-Pin_1) battery source. - MAX3485: U2 VCC +3V3, GND, RO to /NET0007 (J1.16/J8.16), DI to /NET0038 (J1.15/J8.15), DE and /RE tied together Net-(Q3-C) with Q3 C and R18 to GND. TX low -> PNP on -> collector high -> DE high driver enabled, /RE high receiver disabled. This is standard self-switching. Good.

- A/B line bias: R1 2k from +3V3 to /NET0024 (A). R5 2.2k from +3V3 to Net-(U2-B). R24 2.2k from Net-(U2-B) to GND. R7 0 from /NET0024 to J5 signal. There is no B line connection to servo bus? Let's map intended servo interface from spec vs netlist.

But need check values and roles. Spec says R3,R4 1k each series resistors from PWM GPIO nets to servo pin3. Netlist has R8=1k from J5 signal to /NET0010, R11=1k from J7 signal to /NET0013. Good.
